snippets.text: Orbital cellulitis is a rare complication of bacterial rhinosinusitis. However, in most cases of orbital cellulitis, rhinosinusitis is the source of infection. Data show that in up to 86% to 98% of cases of orbital cellulitis, there is coexisting rhinosinusitis present. Moreover, pansinusitis and ethmoid sinusitis are the forms of rhinosinusitis that most likely to lead to orbital cellulitis.[6]
